note: KOA Resort at 613 5th Avenue South, near the beach in Myrtle Beach, under tall pines. --Claude
summary: KOA's own pages confirm 50 A full hookups, pull-throughs, 80-ft max length, Wi-Fi, open all year and koa.com booking. Fees left as quoted 2026-10-19 ($68.94-232.02 before tax). Good Sam false / military true (Good Sam directory) left: KOA's pages are silent. Note trimmed of the prices, hookups and rating the fields hold.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: KOA's own booking form describes a RENTABLE back-in site type as 'relax on your private deck overlooking the water' ('Back-in, Full hookups, 50/30 amp, Cable ... a level concrete patio, then relax on your private deck overlooking the water', reserve site types read 2026-10-19), and the home page says 'the 2 tidal lakes that connect this property to the Atlantic Ocean, through the Withers Swash tidal basin'. A 2026-10-15 review: 'our patio site with a deck on the water was truly amazing'. The entry is 'not waterfront' on the 2026-10-19 audit, which found only an owners' waterfront type and no rentable pad on an open bank of Withers Swash.

Price: base $68.94 is over US$50, but Myrtle Beach is 1 km away (gateways.py), so the gate is lifted. Presence passes (koa.com page and booking). The family has not stayed here. Extended stays (Sep-Apr, up to 9 months, incl. 'short-term contract jobs') are a side business beside a nightly resort, not a long-stay park.
